title: Shared bikes in the city
scene: A local radio news report with two passers-by

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.zh: 各位听众，晚上好。今天我们关注的话题是城市里的共享自行车。
lines.py: Gèwèi tīngzhòng, wǎnshang hǎo. Jīntiān wǒmen guānzhù de huàtí shì chéngshì li de gòngxiǎng zìxíngchē.
lines.en: Good evening, listeners. Today's topic is shared bikes in the city.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.zh: 五年前，我们市开始引进共享自行车。现在全市大约有20万辆，每天的使用次数超过50万次。
lines.py: Wǔ nián qián, wǒmen shì kāishǐ yǐnjìn gòngxiǎng zìxíngchē. Xiànzài quán shì dàyuē yǒu 20 wàn liàng, měi tiān de shǐyòng cìshù chāoguò 50 wàn cì.
lines.en: Our city brought in shared bikes five years ago. There are now about 200,000 of them, used more than 500,000 times a day.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.zh: 对很多上班的人来说，从地铁站到公司的这段路，骑车只要几分钟，既方便又省钱。
lines.py: Duì hěn duō shàngbān de rén lái shuō, cóng dìtiězhàn dào gōngsī de zhè duàn lù, qí chē zhǐ yào jǐ fēnzhōng, jì fāngbiàn yòu shěng qián.
lines.en: For many commuters, the stretch from the subway station to the office takes only a few minutes by bike. It's convenient and cheap.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.zh: 不过，随着车辆越来越多，问题也出现了。一些人把车随意停在路边，甚至停在人行道中间，影响了行人。
lines.py: Búguò, suízhe chēliàng yuè lái yuè duō, wèntí yě chūxiàn le. Yìxiē rén bǎ chē suíyì tíng zài lùbiān, shènzhì tíng zài rénxíngdào zhōngjiān, yǐngxiǎng le xíngrén.
lines.en: But as the number of bikes grew, problems appeared. Some people leave bikes anywhere by the road, even in the middle of the pavement, getting in the way of pedestrians.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.zh: 为了解决这个问题，交通部门从今年三月起，在地铁站附近设置了专门的停车区域。
lines.py: Wèile jiějué zhège wèntí, jiāotōng bùmén cóng jīnnián sān yuè qǐ, zài dìtiězhàn fùjìn shèzhì le zhuānmén de tíngchē qūyù.
lines.en: To deal with this, since March the transport department has set up special parking zones near subway stations.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.zh: 用户如果把车停在区域以外，就无法结束使用，还要继续收费。
lines.py: Yònghù rúguǒ bǎ chē tíng zài qūyù yǐwài, jiù wúfǎ jiéshù shǐyòng, hái yào jìxù shōufèi.
lines.en: If users leave a bike outside a zone, they can't end the ride, and the charge keeps running.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.zh: 记者在一个地铁站门口看到，现在的自行车比以前整齐多了。
lines.py: Jìzhě zài yí ge dìtiězhàn ménkǒu kàndào, xiànzài de zìxíngchē bǐ yǐqián zhěngqí duō le.
lines.en: At the entrance of one station, our reporter saw that the bikes are now much tidier than before.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 以前早上出站，到处都是车，走路都得绕着走。现在好多了，我觉得这个办法挺有效的。
lines.py: Yǐqián zǎoshang chū zhàn, dàochù dōu shì chē, zǒulù dōu děi ràozhe zǒu. Xiànzài hǎo duō le, wǒ juéde zhège bànfǎ tǐng yǒuxiào de.
lines.en: In the mornings there used to be bikes everywhere outside the station, and you had to walk around them. It's much better now. I think it works well.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 我也支持。不过有的时候停车区满了，还得骑到更远的地方去停，挺麻烦的。
lines.py: Wǒ yě zhīchí. Búguò yǒu de shíhou tíngchē qū mǎn le, hái děi qí dào gèng yuǎn de dìfang qù tíng, tǐng máfan de.
lines.en: I support it too. But sometimes the zone is full and you have to ride further away to park, which is a nuisance.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.zh: 对此，管理部门表示，将根据使用情况增加停车区域，并且安排工作人员在高峰时间整理车辆。
lines.py: Duìcǐ, guǎnlǐ bùmén biǎoshì, jiāng gēnjù shǐyòng qíngkuàng zēngjiā tíngchē qūyù, bìngqiě ānpái gōngzuò rényuán zài gāofēng shíjiān zhěnglǐ chēliàng.
lines.en: In response, the authorities said they will add parking zones based on usage and send staff to tidy the bikes at rush hour.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.zh: 此外，部门还提醒市民，骑车时不要戴耳机，注意交通安全。
lines.py: Cǐwài, bùmén hái tíxǐng shìmín, qí chē shí bú yào dài ěrjī, zhùyì jiāotōng ānquán.
lines.en: The department also reminds residents not to wear earphones while cycling and to stay safe on the road.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.zh: 管理部门希望通过这些措施，让共享自行车更好地为市民服务。
lines.py: Guǎnlǐ bùmén xīwàng tōngguò zhèxiē cuòshī, ràng gòngxiǎng zìxíngchē gèng hǎo de wèi shìmín fúwù.
lines.en: The authorities hope these measures will help shared bikes serve residents better.

questions.prompt: 我们市现在大约有多少辆共享自行车？
questions.promptPy: Wǒmen shì xiànzài dàyuē yǒu duōshao liàng gòngxiǎng zìxíngchē?
questions.promptEn: About how many shared bikes does the city have now?
questions.explanation: Line 1 says there are about 200,000 bikes; 500,000 is the number of daily rides.

questions.prompt: 对上班的人来说，共享自行车主要有什么好处？
questions.promptPy: Duì shàngbān de rén lái shuō, gòngxiǎng zìxíngchē zhǔyào yǒu shénme hǎochù?
questions.promptEn: What is the main benefit of shared bikes for commuters?
questions.explanation: Line 2 says the short ride from the station is both convenient and cheap.

questions.prompt: 如果把车停在区域以外，会怎么样？
questions.promptPy: Rúguǒ bǎ chē tíng zài qūyù yǐwài, huì zěnmeyàng?
questions.promptEn: What happens if a bike is left outside a parking zone?
options: 无法结束使用，还要继续收费
questions.explanation: Line 5 says the ride can't be ended and the charge keeps running.

questions.prompt: 男的觉得新办法有什么问题？
questions.promptPy: Nán de juéde xīn bànfǎ yǒu shénme wèntí?
questions.promptEn: What problem does the man see with the new rule?
options: 停车区满了要骑到更远的地方
questions.explanation: In line 8 he says when a zone is full he has to ride further to park; walking around bikes was the woman's old complaint.

questions.prompt: 管理部门打算怎么做？
questions.promptPy: Guǎnlǐ bùmén dǎsuàn zěnme zuò?
questions.promptEn: What do the authorities plan to do?
questions.explanation: Line 9 says they will add parking zones and send staff at rush hour.

questions.prompt: 部门提醒市民骑车时注意什么？
questions.promptPy: Bùmén tíxǐng shìmín qí chē shí zhùyì shénme?
questions.promptEn: What does the department remind cyclists about?
questions.explanation: Line 10 reminds residents not to wear earphones while riding.

title: Selling oranges online
scene: A radio host interviews a young woman who went back to her home village

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 今天的嘉宾是一位年轻人。大学毕业后，她没有留在城市，而是回到家乡，在网上卖水果。欢迎你！
lines.py: Jīntiān de jiābīn shì yí wèi niánqīngrén. Dàxué bìyè hòu, tā méiyǒu liú zài chéngshì, ér shì huídào jiāxiāng, zài wǎngshàng mài shuǐguǒ. Huānyíng nǐ!
lines.en: Today's guest is a young woman who, after university, didn't stay in the city but went home to sell fruit online. Welcome!

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 谢谢主持人，很高兴来到这里。
lines.py: Xièxie zhǔchírén, hěn gāoxìng láidào zhèli.
lines.en: Thank you. I'm glad to be here.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 当初为什么决定回家乡呢？
lines.py: Dāngchū wèi shénme juédìng huí jiāxiāng ne?
lines.en: Why did you decide to go home in the first place?

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 我家乡的橘子特别甜，可是因为交通不方便，以前只能卖给来村里收购的商人，价格压得很低。
lines.py: Wǒ jiāxiāng de júzi tèbié tián, kěshì yīnwèi jiāotōng bù fāngbiàn, yǐqián zhǐ néng mài gěi lái cūn li shōugòu de shāngrén, jiàgé yā de hěn dī.
lines.en: The oranges from my village are very sweet, but transport was poor, so we could only sell to traders who came to buy, and they pushed the price right down.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 我在大学学的是经济，就想，能不能利用网络，把橘子直接卖给城里的消费者。
lines.py: Wǒ zài dàxué xué de shì jīngjì, jiù xiǎng, néng bu néng lìyòng wǎngluò, bǎ júzi zhíjiē mài gěi chéng li de xiāofèizhě.
lines.en: I studied economics at university, so I wondered if we could use the internet to sell the oranges straight to customers in the city.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 刚开始顺利吗？
lines.py: Gāng kāishǐ shùnlì ma?
lines.en: Did it go smoothly at first?

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 一点儿也不顺利。第一年因为包装不好，很多橘子在运输的路上就坏了，客户纷纷要求退钱，我亏了好几万块。
lines.py: Yìdiǎnr yě bú shùnlì. Dì yī nián yīnwèi bāozhuāng bù hǎo, hěn duō júzi zài yùnshū de lù shang jiù huài le, kèhù fēnfēn yāoqiú tuì qián, wǒ kuī le hǎo jǐ wàn kuài.
lines.en: Not at all. In the first year the packaging was poor, so many oranges went bad in transit. One customer after another asked for refunds, and I lost tens of thousands of yuan.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 那你是怎么坚持下来的？
lines.py: Nà nǐ shì zěnme jiānchí xialai de?
lines.en: So how did you keep going?

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 我父母一直支持我。后来我跟快递公司合作，改进了包装，还保证坏了就免费再发。慢慢地，老顾客越来越多。
lines.py: Wǒ fùmǔ yìzhí zhīchí wǒ. Hòulái wǒ gēn kuàidì gōngsī hézuò, gǎijìn le bāozhuāng, hái bǎozhèng huài le jiù miǎnfèi zài fā. Mànmàn de, lǎo gùkè yuè lái yuè duō.
lines.en: My parents always backed me. Later I worked with a delivery company, improved the packaging, and promised to resend any spoiled fruit for free. Little by little, the regular customers grew.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 现在村里其他人也跟着你做吗？
lines.py: Xiànzài cūn li qítā rén yě gēnzhe nǐ zuò ma?
lines.en: Are other people in the village following your lead now?

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 是的。去年村里二十多户人家跟我一起成立了一个小组，大家的收入比以前提高了将近一倍。
lines.py: Shì de. Qùnián cūn li èrshí duō hù rénjiā gēn wǒ yìqǐ chénglì le yí ge xiǎozǔ, dàjiā de shōurù bǐ yǐqián tígāo le jiāngjìn yí bèi.
lines.en: Yes. Last year more than twenty families formed a group with me, and everyone's income nearly doubled.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 你觉得这件事最大的意义是什么？
lines.py: Nǐ juéde zhè jiàn shì zuì dà de yìyì shì shénme?
lines.en: What do you see as the biggest meaning of all this?

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 除了钱以外，更重要的是，很多年轻人愿意回来了，村里又有了活力。
lines.py: Chúle qián yǐwài, gèng zhòngyào de shì, hěn duō niánqīngrén yuànyì huílai le, cūn li yòu yǒu le huólì.
lines.en: Beyond the money, what matters more is that many young people are willing to come back, and the village is lively again.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 最后，你对未来有什么打算？
lines.py: Zuìhòu, nǐ duì wèilái yǒu shénme dǎsuàn?
lines.en: Finally, what are your plans for the future?

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 我想再开发几种当地的特产，比如茶叶和大米，让更多人了解我们的家乡。
lines.py: Wǒ xiǎng zài kāifā jǐ zhǒng dāngdì de tèchǎn, bǐrú cháyè hé dàmǐ, ràng gèng duō rén liǎojiě wǒmen de jiāxiāng.
lines.en: I want to develop a few more local products, like tea and rice, so more people get to know my hometown.

questions.prompt: 以前村里的橘子为什么卖不上好价钱？
questions.promptPy: Yǐqián cūn li de júzi wèi shénme mài bu shàng hǎo jiàqián?

options: 交通不方便，只能卖给商人
questions.explanation: Line 3 says poor transport meant they could only sell to visiting traders who pushed the price down.

questions.prompt: 女的大学学的是什么？

questions.promptEn: What did the woman study at university?
questions.explanation: In line 4 she says she studied economics.

questions.prompt: 第一年为什么亏了钱？
questions.promptPy: Dì yī nián wèi shénme kuī le qián?
questions.promptEn: Why did she lose money in the first year?
options: 包装不好，橘子在路上坏了
questions.explanation: Line 6 says poor packaging let the oranges spoil on the way, so customers wanted refunds.

questions.prompt: 后来她做了什么改变？
questions.promptPy: Hòulái tā zuò le shénme gǎibiàn?
questions.promptEn: What changes did she make later?
options: 改进包装，坏了免费再发
questions.explanation: In line 8 she improved the packaging with a delivery company and promised free replacements.

questions.prompt: 成立小组以后，大家的收入怎么样？
questions.promptPy: Chénglì xiǎozǔ yǐhòu, dàjiā de shōurù zěnmeyàng?
questions.promptEn: What happened to the villagers' income after the group was formed?
questions.explanation: Line 10 says everyone's income nearly doubled.

questions.prompt: 女的认为这件事最大的意义是什么？
questions.promptPy: Nǚ de rènwéi zhè jiàn shì zuì dà de yìyì shì shénme?
questions.promptEn: What does she see as the biggest meaning of her work?
questions.explanation: In line 12 she says, beyond money, the key point is that young people are willing to come back.

title: Complaints about a new app version
scene: A manager and a product colleague review user feedback

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 新版本发布一周了，用户反馈怎么样？
lines.py: Xīn bǎnběn fābù yì zhōu le, yònghù fǎnkuì zěnmeyàng?
lines.en: The new version has been out for a week. What's the user feedback like?

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 下载量比上个版本增加了百分之三十，但是投诉也多了不少，主要集中在两个方面。
lines.py: Xiàzàiliàng bǐ shàng ge bǎnběn zēngjiā le bǎi fēn zhī sānshí, dànshì tóusù yě duō le bù shǎo, zhǔyào jízhōng zài liǎng ge fāngmiàn.
lines.en: Downloads are up thirty percent on the last version, but complaints have risen too. They fall mainly into two areas.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 具体说说。
lines.py: Jùtǐ shuōshuo.
lines.en: Go into detail.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 第一，很多老用户说新版本变化太大，找不到常用的功能；第二，有些旧手机打开很慢，甚至会自动关闭。
lines.py: Dì yī, hěn duō lǎo yònghù shuō xīn bǎnběn biànhuà tài dà, zhǎo bu dào cháng yòng de gōngnéng; dì èr, yǒuxiē jiù shǒujī dǎkāi hěn màn, shènzhì huì zìdòng guānbì.
lines.en: First, many long-time users say the new version changed too much and they can't find the features they use. Second, on some older phones it opens slowly or even shuts down by itself.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 第一个问题我早就担心过。设计的时候，我们太想追求新鲜感，忽视了老用户的习惯。
lines.py: Dì yī ge wèntí wǒ zǎo jiù dānxīn guo. Shèjì de shíhou, wǒmen tài xiǎng zhuīqiú xīnxiāngǎn, hūshì le lǎo yònghù de xíguàn.
lines.en: I was worried about the first one from the start. In the design we wanted something fresh so badly that we ignored long-time users' habits.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 我同意。我建议在设置里加一个功能，让用户可以换回原来的样子。
lines.py: Wǒ tóngyì. Wǒ jiànyì zài shèzhì li jiā yí ge gōngnéng, ràng yònghù kěyǐ huàn huí yuánlái de yàngzi.
lines.en: I agree. I suggest adding an option in settings so users can switch back to the old look.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 这个办法短期内可以，但从长期来看，同时维护两个版本，成本太高了。
lines.py: Zhège bànfǎ duǎnqī nèi kěyǐ, dàn cóng chángqī lái kàn, tóngshí wéihù liǎng ge bǎnběn, chéngběn tài gāo le.
lines.en: That works in the short term, but in the long run maintaining two versions at once costs too much.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 那我们可以在新版本里加一个简单的引导，用户第一次打开时，告诉他们常用功能在哪儿。
lines.py: Nà wǒmen kěyǐ zài xīn bǎnběn li jiā yí ge jiǎndān de yǐndǎo, yònghù dì yī cì dǎkāi shí, gàosu tāmen cháng yòng gōngnéng zài nǎr.
lines.en: Then we could add a simple guide to the new version that shows users where the common features are the first time they open it.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 这个比较可行。那速度的问题呢？
lines.py: Zhège bǐjiào kěxíng. Nà sùdù de wèntí ne?
lines.en: That's more workable. What about the speed problem?

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 技术部门已经找到原因了，是图片太多，旧手机处理不过来。他们说下周就能发布修复版本。
lines.py: Jìshù bùmén yǐjīng zhǎodào yuányīn le, shì túpiàn tài duō, jiù shǒujī chǔlǐ bu guòlái. Tāmen shuō xià zhōu jiù néng fābù xiūfù bǎnběn.
lines.en: The tech team has found the cause: there are too many images, and older phones can't handle them. They say a fix can be released next week.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 下周太晚了，用户等不了那么久。能不能先发一个临时的版本？
lines.py: Xià zhōu tài wǎn le, yònghù děng bu liǎo nàme jiǔ. Néng bu néng xiān fā yí ge línshí de bǎnběn?
lines.en: Next week is too late. Users won't wait that long. Can we put out a temporary version first?

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 我去跟他们商量一下，争取这周五以前解决。
lines.py: Wǒ qù gēn tāmen shāngliang yíxià, zhēngqǔ zhè zhōuwǔ yǐqián jiějué.
lines.en: I'll talk it over with them and aim to fix it before this Friday.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 好。另外，你把投诉的情况整理一下，周四开会的时候向大家汇报。
lines.py: Hǎo. Lìngwài, nǐ bǎ tóusù de qíngkuàng zhěnglǐ yíxià, zhōusì kāihuì de shíhou xiàng dàjiā huìbào.
lines.en: Good. Also, put together a summary of the complaints and report it to everyone at Thursday's meeting.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 好的。我还会给投诉的用户回复，向他们说明我们的改进计划。
lines.py: Hǎo de. Wǒ hái huì gěi tóusù de yònghù huífù, xiàng tāmen shuōmíng wǒmen de gǎijìn jìhuà.
lines.en: Sure. I'll also reply to the users who complained and explain our plan to improve.

questions.prompt: 新版本发布以后，下载量怎么样？
questions.promptPy: Xīn bǎnběn fābù yǐhòu, xiàzàiliàng zěnmeyàng?
questions.promptEn: What happened to downloads after the new version came out?
questions.explanation: Line 1 says downloads rose by thirty percent compared with the last version.

questions.prompt: 老用户对新版本有什么意见？
questions.promptPy: Lǎo yònghù duì xīn bǎnběn yǒu shénme yìjiàn?
questions.promptEn: What do long-time users complain about?
options: 变化太大，找不到常用功能

title: How paper was made
scene: A guide speaks to visitors at a paper museum

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到造纸博物馆。我是今天的讲解员，接下来大约40分钟，我带大家了解纸的历史。
lines.py: Dàjiā hǎo, huānyíng láidào zào zhǐ bówùguǎn. Wǒ shì jīntiān de jiǎngjiěyuán, jiē xiàlái dàyuē 40 fēnzhōng, wǒ dài dàjiā liǎojiě zhǐ de lìshǐ.
lines.en: Hello everyone, and welcome to the Paper Museum. I'm your guide today. For the next forty minutes or so, I'll take you through the history of paper.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.zh: 请大家先看这边。这些是在纸出现以前，人们用来写字的材料。
lines.py: Qǐng dàjiā xiān kàn zhèbian. Zhèxiē shì zài zhǐ chūxiàn yǐqián, rénmen yònglái xiě zì de cáiliào.
lines.en: Please look over here first. These are the materials people wrote on before paper existed.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.zh: 最早，人们把字刻在动物的骨头上，后来又写在用竹子做成的长片上，有钱的人也会写在一种很贵的布上。
lines.py: Zuì zǎo, rénmen bǎ zì kè zài dòngwù de gǔtou shang, hòulái yòu xiě zài yòng zhúzi zuòchéng de cháng piàn shang, yǒu qián de rén yě huì xiě zài yì zhǒng hěn guì de bù shang.
lines.en: At first people carved characters into animal bones. Later they wrote on long strips made of bamboo, and the wealthy also wrote on a very expensive kind of cloth.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.zh: 竹子做的书太重，一本书要用车拉；那种布虽然轻，但是价格太高，普通人用不起。
lines.py: Zhúzi zuò de shū tài zhòng, yì běn shū yào yòng chē lā; nà zhǒng bù suīrán qīng, dànshì jiàgé tài gāo, pǔtōng rén yòng bu qǐ.
lines.en: Bamboo books were so heavy that one book needed a cart. That cloth was light, but it cost too much for ordinary people.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.zh: 大约两千年前，中国人发明了用树皮、旧布等材料造纸的方法。纸既轻又便宜，很快就得到了推广。
lines.py: Dàyuē liǎng qiān nián qián, Zhōngguó rén fāmíng le yòng shùpí, jiù bù děng cáiliào zào zhǐ de fāngfǎ. Zhǐ jì qīng yòu piányi, hěn kuài jiù dédào le tuīguǎng.
lines.en: About two thousand years ago, people in China invented a way of making paper from tree bark, old cloth and other materials. Paper was light and cheap, and it soon spread.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.zh: 现在大家看到的这个模型，展示的就是古代造纸的主要步骤。
lines.py: Xiànzài dàjiā kàndào de zhège móxíng, zhǎnshì de jiù shì gǔdài zào zhǐ de zhǔyào bùzhòu.
lines.en: This model in front of you shows the main steps of making paper in ancient times.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.zh: 首先把原料泡在水里，再把它们打碎；接着用一个细网从水里取出薄薄的一层；最后晒干，一张纸就做好了。
lines.py: Shǒuxiān bǎ yuánliào pào zài shuǐ li, zài bǎ tāmen dǎsuì; jiēzhe yòng yí ge xì wǎng cóng shuǐ li qǔchū báobáo de yì céng; zuìhòu shàigān, yì zhāng zhǐ jiù zuòhǎo le.
lines.en: First the raw materials are soaked in water and beaten to pieces. Then a fine screen lifts a thin layer out of the water. Finally it is dried in the sun, and a sheet of paper is done.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.zh: 这种方法后来传到了亚洲其他国家，又慢慢传到了欧洲，对世界文化的传播起了很大的作用。
lines.py: Zhè zhǒng fāngfǎ hòulái chuándào le Yàzhōu qítā guójiā, yòu mànmàn chuándào le Ōuzhōu, duì shìjiè wénhuà de chuánbō qǐ le hěn dà de zuòyòng.
lines.en: The method later spread to other Asian countries and slowly reached Europe, playing a big part in spreading culture around the world.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 请问，古代的纸能保存多久？
lines.py: Qǐngwèn, gǔdài de zhǐ néng bǎocún duō jiǔ?
lines.en: Excuse me, how long can ancient paper last?

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.zh: 这个问题问得好。如果保存条件合适，有些纸可以保存一千多年。我们博物馆里就有一张一千多年前的纸。
lines.py: Zhège wèntí wèn de hǎo. Rúguǒ bǎocún tiáojiàn héshì, yǒuxiē zhǐ kěyǐ bǎocún yìqiān duō nián. Wǒmen bówùguǎn li jiù yǒu yì zhāng yìqiān duō nián qián de zhǐ.
lines.en: Good question. Under the right conditions, some paper can last over a thousand years. Our museum has a sheet that is more than a thousand years old.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 那现在还有人用这种传统方法造纸吗？
lines.py: Nà xiànzài hái yǒu rén yòng zhè zhǒng chuántǒng fāngfǎ zào zhǐ ma?
lines.en: Does anyone still make paper the traditional way today?

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.zh: 有的。一些地方还保留着传统的手工造纸，主要用来写书法、画中国画。参观结束后，大家可以去体验区亲自动手试一试。
lines.py: Yǒu de. Yìxiē dìfang hái bǎoliú zhe chuántǒng de shǒugōng zào zhǐ, zhǔyào yònglái xiě shūfǎ, huà Zhōngguó huà. Cānguān jiéshù hòu, dàjiā kěyǐ qù tǐyàn qū qīnzì dòngshǒu shì yi shì.
lines.en: Yes. Some places still keep traditional handmade paper, mainly for calligraphy and Chinese painting. After the tour, you can try it yourselves in the hands-on area.

questions.prompt: 讲解大约要多长时间？
questions.promptPy: Jiǎngjiě dàyuē yào duō cháng shíjiān?
questions.promptEn: About how long will the tour last?
questions.explanation: In line 0 the guide says the tour will take about forty minutes.

questions.prompt: 为什么普通人不用那种布写字？
questions.promptPy: Wèi shénme pǔtōng rén bú yòng nà zhǒng bù xiě zì?
questions.promptEn: Why didn't ordinary people write on that cloth?
questions.explanation: Line 3 says the cloth was light but too expensive for ordinary people; heaviness was the problem with bamboo.

questions.prompt: 纸为什么很快得到了推广？
questions.promptPy: Zhǐ wèi shénme hěn kuài dédào le tuīguǎng?
questions.promptEn: Why did paper spread quickly?
questions.explanation: Line 4 says paper was both light and cheap, so it soon spread.

questions.prompt: 造纸的最后一步是什么？
questions.promptPy: Zào zhǐ de zuìhòu yí bù shì shénme?
questions.promptEn: What is the last step in making paper?
options: 从水里取出薄薄的一层
questions.explanation: Line 6 lists the steps and ends with drying the sheet in the sun.

questions.prompt: 关于古代的纸，下面哪一项是对的？
questions.promptPy: Guānyú gǔdài de zhǐ, xiàmiàn nǎ yí xiàng shì duì de?
questions.promptEn: Which statement about ancient paper is true?
options: 条件合适可以保存一千多年
博物馆里没有古代的纸
questions.explanation: Line 9 says under the right conditions paper can last over a thousand years, and the museum has such a sheet.

questions.prompt: 参观结束后，大家可以做什么？
questions.promptPy: Cānguān jiéshù hòu, dàjiā kěyǐ zuò shénme?
questions.promptEn: What can visitors do after the tour?
questions.explanation: In line 11 the guide invites everyone to try making paper themselves in the hands-on area.
